**Alphabet had the higher operating margin in fiscal 2024, by roughly 21.7 percentage points.** The Alphabet figures are from memory of its filing; the Disney figure is an estimate.

- **Alphabet:** operating income was about $112.4B on revenue of about $350.0B, a margin of about 32.1%.
- **Disney:** revenue was about $91.4B. Disney does not report a single operating income line, so I estimated about $9.5B from segment operating income less corporate costs, restructuring and impairment charges, and acquisition-related amortization. That gives a margin of about 10.4%, though the estimate could be off by a point or so.

The difference is 32.1 − 10.4 ≈ 21.7 percentage points.
